findings.reason: The cited evidence confirms the alarm and topology but does not prove the link failure caused the site outages.
T2 explicitly lists the dependency chain S-SUD-001 -> LNK-SUD-01-A -> AGG-SUD-01 and identifies S-SUD-005 as a sibling.
ALM-000151 and T3 both state the alarm was raised at 22:53 and cleared at 02:50 on LNK-SUD-01-A.
T3 shows the site alarms were raised at 22:54, one minute after the link alarm at 22:53, supporting 'immediately following'.
T4 and T5 explicitly report no maintenance or changes on the specified nodes and ancestors during the window.
T6 shows availability and volume dropping to 0 and recovering to baseline levels by 03:00 for S-SUD-001.
